dataList.name: 永動伺服電機
dataList.desc:
Turn Start: This Gift activates for the whole Encounter when 5 or more Identities have Attack Skills that gain [Charge] Count or 'Unique Charge' effects. (except E.G.O Skills; except Backup Units)

Plus Coin Base Attack Skills that consume [Charge] Count or 'Unique Charge'(fixed Potency): gain Coin Power +1 and deal +(sum of [Charge] Count and 'Unique Charge'(fixed Potency) consumed by that Skill x 4)% damage (max 40%)
- Minus Coin Base Attack Skills: Instead of gaining Coin Power, gain Base Power +(4 / # of Coins) (min 1; rounded down)

When allies with [Charge] Count or 'Unique Charge' engage in a Clash with Base Attack Skills: Clash Power +1; gain 2 [AttackUp] at Turn Start for every instance of Clash Win in that Clash during this Encounter. (max 6)

In this Encounter, when an ally takes damage that would kill them, consume all [Charge] Count and 'Unique Charge'(fixed Potency) on self; then, immediately heal (10 + sum of [Charge] Count and 'Unique Charge'(fixed Potency) consumed)% HP (once per Encounter); then, gain 3 [Protection] until the ally is defeated.

※ For 'Unique Charge' that has both Potency and Count, its Count will be used for above calculations
